dedupe_keys.name: desaturation longevity and spatial distribution from microbially induced desaturation mid field trials at the portland oregon sunderland research site

description: Desaturation longevity and spatial distribution from microbially induced desaturation (MID) field trials at the Portland, Oregon Sunderland research site is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Diane Moug, Portland State University (pdx.edu). The research site was treated with Microbially Induced Desaturation (MID) in August 2019 to investigate MID as a liquefaction mitigation approach for fine-grained soils. The site is composed of low plasticity fine-grained soils. The data were collected from 2019 to 2024 to measure the longevity of biogas in situ. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Liquefaction, silts, desaturation. Published 2025-08-04. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
